title: Fix stale-index FCA gap + silent JSON parse failures
description:
From Codex adversarial review of sutra/35.

1. **Stale index loses Rust-specific FCA attrs** — RustAdapter::extract_attributes only reads from language_attrs JSON. Existing DB rows migrated before the language_attrs column have NULL values, and the content-hash skip means they won't be re-parsed until the file changes. Silent false negatives for returns_result, takes_self_ref, returns_self in convention mining.

2. **Malformed language_attrs JSON silently degrades** — serde_json parse error in RustAdapter::extract_attributes is swallowed. Corrupt or version-skewed JSON is indistinguishable from 'no language-specific attributes'."

acceptance_criteria.text: Pipeline invalidates content-hash for files whose symbols have NULL language_attrs, forcing reparse
RustAdapter::extract_attributes logs a warning on malformed language_attrs JSON
Test: simulated stale row (NULL language_attrs) triggers reparse on next index run
Test: malformed JSON in language_attrs produces a warning, not silent degradation
